note: This document contains capability definitions, not a JSON Schema for the registry itself. parameterSchema values are JSON Schemas. No handlers are installed; do not advertise these actions until implemented and tested.

capabilities.description: Show a known ASTRA page. Opening workspace requires an existing explicit workspaceSessionId; navigation never silently creates a session.
capabilities.receipt: Committed screenId and visibleWorkspaceSessionId match request; updated context returned. Repeating same navigation is a no-op success.

capabilities.description: Create one independent blank exam workspace and show it. Do not use for opening an existing exam or on every chat turn.
capabilities.receipt: Return createdWorkspaceSessionId and context after opening it. Replayed action returns same created ID from the action ledger. No generation is started.

capabilities.description: Open the existing preset configuration dialog for an existing draft/error workspace. This action does not approve or generate an exam and does not prefill arbitrary agent-collected requirements.
capabilities.receipt: Dialog visible, configureId bound to explicit target, and openPanels contains exam-setup. Focus is placed in dialog by the UI. Reopening same target is a no-op; never silently retarget an open dialog.

capabilities.description: Set the left navigation to compact or expanded mode without changing the active page or conversation.
capabilities.receipt: Return effective sidebarCollapsed state after React commit. Setting current value is a no-op success. On mobile report CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; don't mutate a hidden preference and claim visual success.

capabilities.description: Submit one backend-validated, teacher-approved pending request through the designated UI generation adapter. The agent must not start a second job separately.
capabilities.receipt: Return confirmed jobId and originating workspaceSessionId once accepted; status success here means job started, not exam completed. Consume approval once; retries resolve same job by idempotency key. Never accept model-supplied raw parameters as proof of validation/approval.
